This tooth powder is packed full of specially chosen ingredients like:\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cul data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\n\u003cli data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\n\u003cstrong data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eHydroxyapatite\u003c\/strong\u003e, the mineral that makes up enamel used to remineralize your teeth and reduce sensitivity\u003c\/li\u003e\n\u003cli data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\n\u003cstrong\u003eArginine Bicarbonate\u003c\/strong\u003e, an amino acid from plants that has been found to have oral health benefits, including reducing sensitivity in teeth.  \u003c\/li\u003e\n\u003cli data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\n\u003cstrong data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eEssential oils\u003c\/strong\u003e\u003cspan data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e \u003c\/span\u003eto help battle gum disease and add a minty taste for fresh breath\u003c\/li\u003e\n\u003cli data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\n\u003cstrong data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eXylitol\u003c\/strong\u003e\u003cspan data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e \u003c\/span\u003eto kill the bad bacteria in the mouth, but leave the good bacteria alone\u003c\/li\u003e\n\u003c\/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSafe for children over 2 years old who spit out their toothpaste.\u003cspan\u003e \u003c\/span\u003eA 2 oz jar lasts about 2 months with twice-daily usage from one person.\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eWho Should Use the Sensitive Tooth Powder? \u003c\/strong\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThose with extra sensitive teeth! Our Remineralizing and Whitening Tooth Powders are both great options for those with sensitive teeth and gums. With arginine bicarbonate as its main ingredient, however, Sensitive Tooth Powder offers an extra layer of technology to seal dentinal tubules, reducing teeth sensitivity with the added benefit of remineralizing.\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\n\u003cspan style=\"font-size: 1.4em;\"\u003eIngredients\u003c\/span\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\n\u003c\/h3\u003e\n\u003cp data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eCalcium Carbonate, Xylitol, Bentonite Clay, Hydroxyapatite Powder, Arginine Bicarbonate, Mentha Viridis (Spearmint) Essential Oil, \u003cspan data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003ePlantain (Plantago Major) Leaf Extract, Gaultheria Procumbens (Wintergreen) Leaf Oil, Mentha Piperita (Peppermint) Oil,\u003c\/span\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eDirections\u003c\/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWet toothbrush and dip in powder. Brush for two minutes and spit. Avoid rinsing after for maximum benefits. Recommended use two times per day.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eFAQs\u003cbr\u003e\n\u003c\/h3\u003e\n\u003cp data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDoes this tooth powder replace my toothpaste?\u003c\/strong\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cp data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eYes! It is meant to be used in place of a traditional toothpaste. \u003cbr data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eIs a tooth powder better than a toothpaste?\u003c\/strong\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cp data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eIt all depends on the ingredients. Tooth paste is commonly made using glycerin which helps turn the paste into a paste. However, studies are showing that toothpastes that contain hydroxyapatite may not be as effective when glycerin is an ingredient. This is because the glycerin can coat the teeth and physically block them from absorbing as much hydroxyapatite for remineralization.\u003cbr data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\u003cbr data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eWe chose to create a tooth powder with hydroxyapatite to help the teeth absorb as much as possible for maximized remineralization benefits.\u003cbr\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eIs the tooth powder safe for children and can it be swallowed?\u003c\/strong\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cp data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eYes, our tooth powders are safe for children! We recommend either the Kids Tooth Powder (citrus) or the Remineralizing Tooth Powder (mint). Both versions are safe for kids and can be swallowed, we just know that littles don’t always love minty toothpaste so we made a citrus version for them. \u003cbr data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\u003cbr data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eIf your child is over two years of age and able to spit out their regular toothpaste, then the Whitening Remineralizing Tooth Powder (mint) is safe for them to use.\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cp data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eHow long will one jar of tooth powder last?\u003c\/strong\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cp data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eA jar of tooth powder can last a single person 2 months with twice-daily brushing. \u003cbr data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eDoes each person in my family need their own jar of tooth powder?\u003c\/strong\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cp data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eThat’s up to you! It’s very similar to sharing a tube of toothpaste as your wet toothbrush picks up what it touches. But if you prefer not to share, get each person their own jar!\u003cbr data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\u003cbr data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eAlternatively, you can use a UV toothbrush sanitizer before dipping your toothbrush in the jar to reduce the spread of bacteria.\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cp data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCan the tooth powder help with receding gums?\u003c\/strong\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003cp data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003eThe tooth powder can help with gum health, but receding gums generally require a skin graft.\u003cstrong\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003c\/strong\u003e\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 data-mce-fragment=\"1\"\u003e\n\u003cstrong\u003eResearch\u003c\/strong\u003e\u003cspan\u003e\u003c\/span\u003e\n\u003c\/h3\u003e\n\u003cdiv data-element_type=\"column\" data-id=\"24b4bc8\" class=\"elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-inner-column elementor-element elementor-element-24b4bc8\"\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated\"\u003e\n\u003cdiv data-widget_type=\"text-editor.default\" data-element_type=\"widget\" data-id=\"746ccb2\" class=\"elementor-element elementor-element-746ccb2 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor\"\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"elementor-widget-container\"\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eAmaechi, B.T.; AbdulAzees, P.A.; Okoye, L.O.; Meyer, F.; Enax, J. toothpastes.\u003c\/p\u003e\n\u003c\/div\u003e\n\u003c\/div\u003e\n\u003c\/div\u003e\n\u003c\/div\u003e\n\u003c\/div\u003e\n\u003c\/div\u003e\n\u003c\/div\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"wpb_row vc_row-fluid
